scripts.dev: pnpm build:worker-deps && concurrently --names dashboard,worker --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @morning-signal/dashboard dev" "pnpm --filter @morning-signal/worker dev"
scripts.build: pnpm build:worker-deps && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/worker build && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/dashboard build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @morning-signal/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/storage typecheck && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/collector typecheck && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/candidates typecheck && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/worker typecheck && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/dashboard typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.build:worker-deps: pnpm --filter @morning-signal/contracts build && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/storage build && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/collector build && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/candidates build
scripts.db:init: pnpm build:worker-deps && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/worker exec tsx src/cli.ts db init
scripts.db:status: pnpm build:worker-deps && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/worker exec tsx src/cli.ts db status
scripts.sources: pnpm build:worker-deps && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/worker exec tsx src/cli.ts sources
scripts.collect: pnpm build:worker-deps && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/worker exec tsx src/cli.ts collect
scripts.collect:dry: pnpm build:worker-deps && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/worker exec tsx src/cli.ts collect --dry-run
scripts.daily:preflight: pnpm build:worker-deps && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/worker exec tsx src/cli.ts daily preflight
scripts.candidates:prepare: pnpm build:worker-deps && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/worker exec tsx src/cli.ts prepare
scripts.draft:validate: pnpm build:worker-deps && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/worker exec tsx src/cli.ts draft validate
scripts.draft:import: pnpm build:worker-deps && pnpm --filter @morning-signal/worker exec tsx src/cli.ts draft import
